name: loupe
title: Loupe
description: A goldsmith's counter: every product is headed by a bevelled silver bar struck like a hallmark and laid on black display velvet, its category in a lozenge-ended cartouche, its status in a shield, its price in heavy bright figures in a cut-corner punch. The light scheme is tissue white, and the silver keeps its velvet tray.

tokens.--font-text: the geometric sans of body text, headings and product names
tokens.--font-caps: the small spaced capitals: shop name, menu, category and status marks, labels, section headings
tokens.--font-figure: the heavy lining figures of the price punch and the phone number
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capitals
tokens.--price-size: size of the price figures in a punch; the product page sets them up to half as large again, a long price a quarter smaller
tokens.--color-bg: page background: display velvet (tissue paper in the light scheme)
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, product names and the menu
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: labels, dates, opening times, quotes, table headings, list markers, page numbers, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links, the line under the current menu item and focus rings
tokens.--color-line: thin rules: under the masthead, between rows of lists, tables and opening hours, round a photograph, above the footer
tokens.--color-pad: the how-to-order card, the ground of code in page text, and the skip link
tokens.--color-velvet: the velvet tray the silver bars lie on, in both schemes: product lists and the head of a product page
tokens.--color-velvet-text: product names, links and focus rings on the velvet
tokens.--color-velvet-muted: descriptions, underlines and a sold-out product's name on the velvet
tokens.--color-velvet-line: the hairline round the velvet tray
tokens.--color-bar: the face of the silver bars and of the hallmark by the shop name and under the home headline; the silver rules on lists, tables, section headings, quotes and the how-to-order card; a sold-out price
tokens.--color-bar-bevel: the bright top bevel of a bar, and the thin bright lip along the lower right of each punch
tokens.--color-bar-side: the left and right bevels of a bar
tokens.--color-bar-foot: the dark bottom bevel of a bar
tokens.--color-bar-sheen: the polish on a bar: the light from above, and the glint that crosses it on hover
tokens.--color-bar-shade: the shade along the foot of a bar's face
tokens.--color-tarnish: the face of a sold-out product's bar
tokens.--color-engrave: words engraved on the silver: the unit beside the price, In stock on the product page, a status with no shield
tokens.--color-punch: the sunk ground of a punch: cartouche, shield, price and the round rose mark
tokens.--color-punch-shade: the shadow the upper and left walls throw inside each punch
tokens.--color-figure: figures and letters standing bright in a punch; the rose, crown and brilliant of the hallmark
tokens.--shadow-bar: the thin dark edge under a bar
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text, and of the details and news lists
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of bars, the how-to-order card and code
tokens.--bevel: width of a bar's bevels and of the silver edge on quotes and the how-to-order card
tokens.--cut: depth of a punch's cut corners; a cartouche's pointed ends are half as deep again
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a label and its value
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between punches, inside list rows
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens, paragraph spacing, padding of code blocks
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks and between products
tokens.--space-5: large gap: between the two columns, above the how-to-order card
